decisions.state_note: o000: visible window approximately x154–217, y81–144; mostly white, with a black wedge entering at its upper-left corner. Shape identity remains unclear.

o002: window x122–185, y49–112 shows black reaching a rounded right tip near (176,76), then slanting down-left. A white notch enters from the left around y74–94. Digit remains uncertain.

o003: window x90–153, y49–112 shows broad black area with a narrow white diagonal opening from about (105,100) to (148,76); white also enters the upper-left corner. Opening may be part of a loop; digit uncertain.
o004: window x90–153, y81–144 shows broad black diagonal mass, a white opening near (105–137,81–102), and white to the lower right. Lower structure remains unseen; possible loop-bearing digit.

o005: window x90–153, y113–176 shows a thick black stroke slanting down-left, with white to its right and a small white notch entering the left near y132–155. Lower termination remains unseen; a 9 is a hypothesis.

o006: window x90–153, y145–208 shows black slanting down-left from x102–130 at top to the left edge near y200; white fills the lower-right. Stroke continues beyond left boundary; 9 remains a hypothesis.

o007: window x58–121, y145–208 shows a thick diagonal descending left from the upper-right edge toward (68,205), with white on both sides. Its lower end meets the window boundary; 9 remains a hypothesis.

o008: window x58–121, y113–176 shows a rounded black lobe ending near (84,136), white beneath it, and a black stroke along the right curving down-left. Upper-left structure is still unknown; 9 remains a hypothesis.

o009: window x58–121, y81–144 shows a rounded black lobe around x64–104, y102–136, connected to black above and at right; a white notch enters from the upper right near y90–102. Upper contour remains unseen; 9 is still a hypothesis.

o010: window x58–121, y49–112 shows black widening down-left from the upper-right edge toward (77,95), with a white notch entering from the right near y84–102. Upper contour remains cropped; 9 remains a hypothesis.
o011: window x58–121, y17–80 is white except for black entering the lower-right, with an edge rising from about (79,80) to (121,49). Top of the digit remains unseen; 9 remains a hypothesis.
